title: Small recliner, looks great and it's comfortable.
text: Small recliner, looks great and it's comfortable.. This is a very nice recliner.  I love it!  I'm giving it 5 stars because, it is perfect for me.  I'm only 5 feet tall and this is the first recliner to fit me.  My feet reach the ground perfectly, unlike other recliners.  If you need a small recliner this one is comfortable, easy to assemble and is attractive!  If you need something big, you need to keep searching.

product_metadata.title: La-Z-Boy Anderson Rocking Recliner, Sand
features: Rocks and reclines for total comfort
Adjust the legrest with a convenient side-mounted handle
3-position locking legrest for added safety and support
Double-picked blown fiber fill for improved cushion loft and shape retention
High grade foam seat cushions that maintain their comfort and appearance
description: The perfect place to unwind, Anderson pairs the comfort of a recliner with the soothing motion of a rocker. Designed to complement any decor, Anderson is upholstered in a natural Sand fabric accented by a rich finish on the handle and rocker base. Smaller in scale, Anderson features a plush seat and legrest along with soft padded arms. A tapered, channel-stitched back provides total body and lumbar support whether you are rocking or reclining. Easily adjust the 3-position locking legrest with an easy-to-reach handle, or lean back without raising your feet. With Anderson, there are no limit to how you can lounge.
